_comment: Single source of truth for the CyberFox Lab tools. tools/build_zips.sh builds one flashable zip per entry; tools/gen_lab_page.py builds the Lab page from the same list.

tools.title: Backup critical partitions
tools.desc: boot, vendor_boot, dtbo, vbmeta, efs, persist

tools.title: Restore critical partitions
tools.desc: Newest backup to active slot, SHA-256 checked

tools.title: File Vault: back up my files
tools.desc: Photos, downloads, docs, music to USB-OTG

tools.title: File Vault: restore my files
tools.desc: Newest vault back to storage, fixes owners

tools.title: Disable AVB / verity
tools.desc: Patches vbmeta on both slots (may need Format)

tools.title: Switch active slot
tools.desc: Marks the other A/B slot active for next boot

tools.title: Bootloop rescue
tools.desc: Disables all Magisk / KernelSU / APatch modules

tools.title: Restore stock recovery
tools.desc: Saved stock vendor_boot to both slots

tools.title: Device report
tools.desc: Props, partitions, mounts, logs to Reports
